bullets.text: As an individual contribution to a supervised course team project, wrote Python functions to parse provided company report records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.
Under supervision, validated SQL joins for company report metadata with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and visualized how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules.
As an individual contribution to supervised team research, wrote Python functions to parse provided public policy records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.
Under supervision, validated SQL joins for public policy metadata with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and visualized how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules.

As an individual contribution to supervised team research, wrote Python functions to parse provided programming question records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.
Under supervision, joined programming question document identifiers to metadata using SQL, checked unmatched records, visualized group comparisons, and documented missing-data handling.
